title: Feasibility Studies Preparation, Analysis and Evaluation
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential skills needed to prepare, analyze, and evaluate feasibility studies. Through hands-on training using Microsoft Excel, participants will learn how to construct a comprehensive financial model for feasibility studies. The course also focuses on appraising service and industrial investments using various capital budgeting techniques and analyzing key financial metrics.
audience: This course is ideal for project sponsors, senior management, functional managers, project managers, and anyone involved in the preparation, writing, and analysis of feasibility studies. Participants will earn 30 Professional Development Units (PDUs) upon completion.
methodology: The course combines interactive techniques, including brief presentations by the consultant and participants, group exercises, and case studies. A significant portion of the course involves building a feasibility study model using Microsoft Excel.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define the concept of a feasibility study and differentiate it from a business plan
Identify the critical components of a feasibility study
Develop a financial model for a feasibility study using Microsoft Excel
Apply various investment appraisal techniques and interpret financial metrics
Assess the strengths and weaknesses of a feasibility study
